messages:
rachel_sales: Heads-up team — HelixPay POC hitting heavy 429s during their integration smoke tests. They say traffic is only ~600 RPS but our logs show one pod getting hammered. Theyre asking for a short exec summary for procurement and a provisional dedicated pricing sheet.

owen_platform: Can you paste a few sample request ids / timestamps?

rachel_sales: Customer pasted this log chunk: 
```
[2026-02-28T14:12:03Z] req=hp-33a1 status=429 route=/v1/generate pod=ri-pod-07 conn=512
[2026-02-28T14:12:04Z] req=hp-33af status=429 route=/v1/generate pod=ri-pod-07 conn=519
```

tariq_sre: That pattern looks like sticky routing to a single pod. Could be client-side DNS TTL or load balancer affinity. Also check our rate limiter per-pod token-bucket.

meera_se: HelixPay said they used the SDK with default keepalive and a custom retry wrapper. They indicated their env has a NAT gateway leading to sticky source IPs.

owen_platform: infra-bot, fetch pod metrics for ri-pod-07 and cluster helix-poc-zoneA for 14:00-14:20 UTC.

infra-bot: metrics: ri-pod-07 cpu=78% mem=61% conn=540 qps=1200 error_429=23% (14:00-14:20) ; cluster avg qps/pod=220 ; runtime=ri-0.14.3

tariq_sre: Confirmed. ri-pod-07 had significantly higher qps than peers. This is causing its local token-bucket to exhaust faster and return 429s. We should instruct the customer to disable long-lived connections or use our load-balancer-friendly SDK options that round-robin connections.

rachel_sales: Customer is sensitive about changing their infra — they want to know if we can rate-balance on our side while they adjust. Also asking about EU data residency and whether Dedicated can be in eu-west-1.

meera_se: We can enable connection rebalancer on the ingress layer as a mitigation: it will spread existing TCP connections across backends for 30m while they fix client-side behavior. It's a safe toggle. Also Dedicated is available in eu-west-1 but reserved capacity lead time is ~10 business days for 5k TPS.

owen_platform: infra-bot, run: enable-conn-rebalancer --cluster helix-poc-zoneA --duration 30m --owner tariq_sre

infra-bot: job started: enable-conn-rebalancer id=job-7782 owner=tariq_sre -> completed in 18s

rachel_sales: Sending that to Helix and asking for SOC2 evidence and data residency confirmation. They also want a pricing comparison: 5k reserved (monthly) vs hosted burst.

finance-bot: Quick calc: 5k reserved estimate = $38,000/mo (base) ; burst buffer 10k = +$12,000/mo provisional. Need sales to confirm expected month-to-month usage profile for final quote.

meera_se: Helix asked if we can run a short test: 1) we simulate 600 RPS from distributed clients to verify rebalancer; 2) they will run their real traffic. Can scheduling ops run 30-min window tomorrow?

owen_platform: I'll schedule a run in the morning maintenance window 09:00 UTC. infra-bot, reserve slot.

infra-bot: maintenance slot reserved: 2026-03-02T09:00:00Z duration=30m owner=owen_platform

tariq_sre: Also flag: older SDK versions had an aggressive retry backoff that amplified retries on 429s. Recommend customer use SDK >= 2.3.1 and our recommended retry policy: jittered-exponential with max_attempts=3.

rachel_sales: Theyre on SDK 2.1.0. I'll push them to upgrade. Procurement team also asked if we can sign a short MSA addendum to allow them to start POC while SOC2 upload is pending.

meera_se: Security note: temporary exceptions require signed NDA + clearly scoped data handling statement. I'll draft a template they can sign; legal will need to okay.

nowen_platform: infra-bot, add alert rule: if pod 429 rate > 5% for 5m across cluster, create paging alert to oncall. Owner=tariq_sre

infra-bot: alert rule created id=alert-9931 owner=tariq_sre

rachel_sales: Customer reports after we enabled conn-rebalancer their 429s dropped to single-digit percents and success rate improved. They're happy to upgrade SDK and schedule the load test.

finance-bot: Noted. Finance requests expected POC length (weeks) and estimated avg RPS to prepare a provisional billing plan. Rachel please ping with numbers.

rachel_sales: Will send estimated 6-week POC, avg 600 RPS, peak 1.2k RPS. Asking for a provisional quote by EOD.

meera_se: I'll attach the data-residency doc and compliance portal link. Also adding a short troubleshooting snippet for customers with NAT/source-IP stickiness: 
```
1) check client NAT sizes / ephemeral IP pool
2) enable SDK round-robin: SDK.setConnectionAffinity(false)
3) if using LB NAT, consider client-side connection pooling per endpoint
```

nowen_platform: Great. Postmortem candidate: cause = client-side source-IP affinity + old SDK retries -> pod hotspotting -> token-bucket exhaustion -> 429s. Mitigations: conn-rebalancer, alert rule, SDK upgrade doc.

rachel_sales: Helix procurement asked for the exec summary now. I'll draft and circulate this thread + finance quote. Thanks team :thumbsup:
